name.description: Name of the application that `apt-get` recognizes. Specify a version of a package by following the package name with an equal sign and the version, e.g., `vim=2:8.2.3995-1ubuntu2.7`.

path.description: The path where the application is installed by `apt-get` after Terraform creates this resource.

block.description:
`installer_apt` manages an application using [APT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/APT_(software)).

It works on systems that use APT as the package management system. Adding an `installer_apt` resource means that Terraform will ensure that the application defined in the `name` argument is made available via APT.

environment.description: are the environment variables set during the installation.

name.description: is the name of the plugin. See `installer_asdf_plugin`.

path.description: is the path of the application installed by asdf after Terraform creates the resource.

version.description: is the version of the plugin that asdf should install.

block.description: `installer_asdf` manages a specify version of application using [asdf](https://asdf-vm.com/).

environment.description: are the environment variables set during the installation.

git_url.description: is the Git repository's URL which will be added as the plugin if specified.

name.description: is the name of the plugin.
Name of the application that `brew` recognizes, e.g., `homebrew/cask/alfred` for a cask, `goreleaser/tap/goreleaser` for tap. Treats a package as a formula if `cask` is not set or false

path.description: The path where the application is installed by `brew` after Terraform creates this resource.

block.description:
`installer_brew` manages an application using [Homebrew](https://brew.sh/).

It works on systems that use Homebrew as the package management system. Adding an `installer_brew` resource means that Terraform will ensure that the application defined in the `name` argument is made available via brew.

install_script.description: is the script that will be called by Terraform when executing `terraform plan/apply`.

path.description: is the location of the application installed by the install script. If the application does not exist at path, the resource is considered not exist by Terraform

uninstall_script.description: is the script that will be called by Terraform when executing `terraform destroy`.

block.description:
`installer_script` manages an application using a custom script.

Adding an `installer_script` resource means that Terraform will install application in the `path` by running the `install_script` when creating the resource.
